newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries end mixed, stocks tumble, NAPM eyed.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries end mixed, stocks tumble, NAPM eyed.

text.p: *US Treasuries ended mixed as shorter maturities benefitted from desire for liquidity. Stock slide, quarter-end portfolio adjustments said to aid short end. Dow tumbles 2.33 percent. *Long end wary of NAPM on Tuesday. Reuters poll forecasts NAPM at 53.6 vs Feb 53.1. Prices paid, supplier deliveries eyed.
